Quirkless.name: Quirkless
Quirkless.description:
🧠 You have no Quirk. You make up for it with study, planning, gear and nerve, and you learn to read other people's Quirks closely.

🧩 Also pick No Quirk, No Drawback (Quirkless) and No Quirk Strength (Quirkless) in the other Quirk categories.
🎯 Good for planners and gear users who win on wits and nerve.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Analysis +10, Combat Tactics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: First-Look Read, Bait-and-Slip, Special Move Training
Quirkless.traitNarrativeEffects: No Quirk: the age-four registration found none (X-ray: the extra little-toe joint); records say Quirkless. No Quirk Strain or drawback; never develops a Quirk; no Quirk Breakthrough. Overrides other Quirk picks: any other Family, Drawback or Strength is void; no Quirk techniques. Quirk-targeting finds nothing: Aizawa's Erasure has nothing to stop, copiers get nothing by touch, boosters nothing to act on. Uses knowledge, prep, legal support gear, tactics and nerve: studies Quirks, spots limits and tells, plans routes and exits. Techniques cost stamina or nothing, never Strain. Law: being Quirkless is legal; weapons and gear follow ordinary law and permits. Society: about one in five is Quirkless; pity, low expectations, bullying (useless, steered from hero work, a family disappointment). Schools and agencies assume no hero work; a licensed Quirkless hero makes news. Foes underestimate them; villains see easy prey or disposable help.
